description: Calculate the one-off costs of buying residential property in Austria on top of the price (Kaufnebenkosten): real estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer), land-register court fees, broker commission with a check against the legal maximum, and lawyer/notary contract costs, each with VAT where it applies. Use when someone asks what buying a specific flat or house in Austria costs in total. The JSON lists the cited legal bases and sources once; pass detail "full" for every line item with its calculation and its own citations. Amounts in EUR. Not covered: bank or valuation fees, purchases within the family, exemptions for a primary residence.

assumptions.description: Override default assumptions. Omit to use documented defaults.

contractFeePct.description: Lawyer/notary contract and escrow fee, % of price excl. VAT. Default 1.5 (typical range 1–3).

grundbuchApplications.description: Number of separate land-register applications. Default 1.

grundbuchFiling.description: How the land-register application is filed. Default "electronic" (lawyer or notary).

mortgageRegistrationFactor.description: Registered mortgage as a multiple of the loan. Default 1.3.

commissionPct.description: Buyer's broker commission in % of the price, EXCLUDING 20% VAT. Listings often say '3% zzgl. 20% USt' → 3.

sellerPaysCommission.description: Whether the seller also pays the broker. Affects the legal cap. Omit if unknown.

broker.description: Broker commission, or "none" if the purchase is commission-free (provisionsfrei).

detail.description: How much of the result to return as JSON. "summary" (default) keeps the key figures, flags, assumptions, limitations and deduplicated citations (about 40% of the size for underwrite_property, 60% for estimate_acquisition_costs). "full" adds every line item with its calculation and citations, the tax years and the rules used. The readable text is the same in both.

financing.description: Mortgage financing, if any. Adds the court fee for registering the mortgage.

registeredMortgageAmount.description: Mortgage amount registered in the land register, if known. Defaults to 1.3 × the loan.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in EUR (the agreed price for the property), e.g. 249000.

valuationDate.description: Date whose rules apply, YYYY-MM-DD, usually today or the expected signing date. Defaults to today (Vienna time). Covered: 2025-04-01 to 2027-12-31.

name: estimate_acquisition_costs
title: Austrian property purchase costs
